name: JitForge
tagline: Enterprise In-Memory Java JIT & Bytecode Microservice Engine on Java 21 Loom Virtual Threads.
description:
High-performance in-memory Java runtime compilation, JIT execution, and cloud-native bytecode synthesis engine. Compiles and executes dynamic Java code entirely in RAM with zero disk I/O, sub-millisecond caching, and 4-tier storage hierarchy.

Core Capabilities & Architecture

⚡ In-Memory Compilation

Zero interface or base class constraints. Pass plain Java source code and let the engine infer AST definitions. In-memory ClassLoader links dependencies in RAM with zero disk footprint.

🌐 Cloud-Native REST Microservice

Engineered on Java 21 Loom Virtual Threads for high-concurrency workloads. Exposes REST endpoints for compilation (/api/compile), execution (/api/execute), and metrics.

⚙️ Dynamic Multi-Engine Switching

Clients dynamically select engines per request: standard JAVAC, ultra-low-latency JANINO (<15ms JIT), or Apache Groovy (@CompileStatic).

💾 4-Tier Distributed Bytecode Storage

Chain-of-responsibility hierarchy: RAM / ClassLoader (<1µs) → Redis Cache (<1ms) → Pod Local Volume (2-5ms) → PostgreSQL DB (5-15ms).

📦 Direct Bytecode Streaming

Remote client JVMs load and execute server-compiled classes dynamically via standard HTTP URLClassLoader streams (/api/classes/...) or Base64 JSON payloads.

🔒 Enterprise Security & AST Sandboxing

Lexical token and AST rule validator proactively rejects unauthorized operations (ProcessBuilder, System.exit, reflection). SandboxedExecutor enforces execution timeouts.

🚀 Microservice REST API

Step 1: Compile Dynamic Code in RAM
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/compile \ 
  -d '{"compiler":"JANINO","source":"..."}'
Step 2: Direct URLClassLoader Streaming
URL[] urls = { URI.create("http://localhost:8080/api/classes/").toURL() };
URLClassLoader loader = new URLClassLoader(urls, getClassLoader());
